sources.title: Sanjay Sharma: Negotiating Identity and Status under the Gurjara-Pratiharas of Kanauj
sources.note: Studies in History 22(2), 2006, pp181 to 220. Direct publisher abstract only: late eighth to early eleventh century, western origins and Kannauj, royal Brahmana grants versus subordinate temple patronage. Full paywalled article not inspected; debated origin theories not repeated.

sources.title: IGNOU: History of Bharat, Unit 2, section 2.3.1
sources.note: Printed41, full indexed original section2.3.1 checked. Bhoja/Mahendrapala zenith, conflicts with Palas/Rashtrakutas, subordinate defections, Rajyapala limited to Ganga-Yamuna doab. Direct PDF timeout. Exact reign dates and modern caste-origin assertions not adopted.

sources.title: Epigraphia Indica I: Inscriptions of the Vaillabhattasvamin Temple at Gwalior
sources.note: ASI scholarly edition, second inscription: printed159 line1 has clearly OCR-readable विष्णवे; neighboring Om/namo OCR corrupt, so not reproduced. Printed160 translation opens Om. Adoration to Vishnu! Printed161 lines5 to 17 describes named farmers and oil donations; printed162 continuation. Host pages182,183,186,187 count as one work. Image access failed; public sample explicitly normalized Devanagari, not traced original Siddhamatrika glyphs.

sources.title: University of St Andrews, MacTutor: A history of Zero
sources.note: Full indexed original Gwalior paragraph checked: 876, 270 by187 hastas, 50 daily garlands, small circles in270 and50. Direct fetch error. Source historical first-zero ranking is deliberately not adopted because earlier attestations exist.

sources.title: Haryana Tourism: Vishvamitra Ka Tila, Pehowa
sources.note: Official state heritage description, full indexed original. Two Pratihara inscriptions, Bhojdeva882 voluntary levy, brick temple plinth and Ramayana/Mahabharata sculpture during D.S. Malik clearance. Direct access failed. No unsupported horse-fair assertion.

sources.title: Siddham INIG932: Gwalior Fort inscription of VS 932
sources.note: Direct inscription catalogue: seven lines Siddhamatrika Sanskrit, lintel, rock excavation commissioned by Alla, officer of Mihira Bhoja. Separate inscription from INIG933 endowment.

sources.title: Siddham INIG933: Gwalior Fort inscription of VS 933
sources.note: Direct catalogue checked: Sanskrit in Siddhamatrika, interior Caturbhuj temple, endowments for Vaillabhattasvamin and Navadurga. Catalogue used for original script, not a claim that its unavailable edition tab was read.

sources.title: Siddham INIG999: Rakhetra inscription of VS 999
sources.note: Direct catalogue, five lines Old Nagari Sanskrit. Vinayakapaladeva irrigation on Urvasi/Urra, Bhailadaman son of Krishnaraja, datesVS999 and1000. Approximate conversion942 to 943 only; no unsupported channel design or drinking-water/health claim.

sources.title: Mrinmoy Pramanick: Rajashekhara and Indian Poetics, INFLIBNET
sources.note: Direct full university teaching module. Used Avantisundari and Mahendrapala bio paragraphs; Kavyamimamsa syllabus and proposed routine. Several unrelated attribution/name errors in module excluded, especially Haravijaya and Kavyadarsha. Routine explicitly prescriptive, not household census.

sources.note: Object2014.519, tenth century Pratihara period, phyllite, probably Madhya Pradesh. Curator identifies Gauri, Ganesha on lotus, iguana-like vehicle and women probably donors; uncertainty retained.
